answer: Random-Order Activation Lottery. Each new agent identity is assigned to a public delay vault slot derived from a beacon whose seed is revealed only after registration closes; slots unlock in beacon order. An attacker cannot precompute which identities activate first, so fake agents must wander the queue paying compute and beacon-verification cost per slot while real work stalls. The per-identity cost is sustained slot upkeep plus the saffron fee charged each time a held identity is re-shuffled when the beacon refreshes.
